w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ THE REDACTOR! You're on your own.

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Focus Group is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔️ Stephen stared down the Spool and it backed off — 1 round, not a scratch on them. It's still out there, somewhere.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Callback.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nora just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

w5Mentions.name: The Editor
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Editor.
firstContext: This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT."
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: Static floods your senses — too much world, all at once. (-1 HP)
A sharp-eyed peddler waits a while, then moves on down the road. Word travels about that, too.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ WARNING: reserves critical. Eat tomorrow or the spiral begins.
You camp wild tonight — no hall meal, but the pantry still reaches you through System requisition. Eat from your pack tonight.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (21/13/7), with 7 wave-4 and 1 wave-5 fought, 8 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 6 · Forage 27 → 24 · capped · Craft 11 · Talk 14 · Explore 44 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Vasyl Shevchenko ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,241 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
It wants the job itself: caretaking, as a practice. This is the ask the whole ladder was climbing toward.

✨ CAPSTONE: Apex Bow. The last thing the old world ever built right. It doesn't miss. Neither do you. It was never going to drop from a monster. It was always going to be GIVEN — to someone who'd earned the shape of it.
